title: Digital Product Passport Schema for Construction Materials
description: Standardized schema for converting Technical Data Sheets (TDS) into machine-readable Digital Product Passport (DPP) JSON format for the ConstructAsk platform

passport_id.description: Unique passport identifier with DPP- prefix

product_name.description: Commercial product name as stated on TDS

description.description: Brief product description and primary function

technical_properties.description: Engineering parameters extracted from TDS. Each property should include value, unit, and test_method where applicable

standards_compliance.description: List of applicable standards (ISO, EN, BIS, ASTM)

packaging_and_storage.description: Packaging, storage requirements, and shelf life

sustainability.description: Environmental and sustainability data including carbon footprint

qr_verification.description: QR code and verification URL for ConstructAsk integration

source_document.description: Provenance of the original TDS document and conversion metadata

data_rights.description: Manufacturer permission, data reuse rights, and publication constraints

evidence.description: Field-level citations, confidence threshold, and quality notes

audit_trail.description: Append-only lifecycle events for DPP creation, review, publication, and updates
